**Finding submitted — RENEWAL: deviation at Article IV (p0049).**

- **Issue:** The Licensor holds a unilateral option to renew the 36-month Initial Period for a further **seven years**, with no Licensee opt-out, notice window, or reminder. That is walk-away territory (one-sided multi-year renewal) and fails the fallback outright; it also contradicts the retained mutual-extension mechanics in Article IV.II and IV.III.
- **Cure (preferred level, one surgical replace):** the Licensor-option sentence becomes "The Agreement may be renewed only by mutual written agreement of the parties." Because renewal is then non-automatic and no unilateral pricing right survives, the conditional automatic-renewal and price-uplift elements are satisfied without adding notice, reminder, or CPI machinery.
- **Checked and left alone:** fee tiers (p0057–p0063) are fixed with no renewal uplift language, so no cap was volunteered; termination-for-breach language in the same paragraph was preserved verbatim.
